reason: The default (tonic) response only takes examples (plural, fizz.DefaultResponseExamples); fizz.Response/ResponseWith with its code is rejected as a duplicate, so a single media-type example cannot be set.
Counterpart of the missing singular example: the same payload is written as examples.list.value, the closest fizz can say.
A body field that is required loses its default tag, with a warning (README, default tag). A required property that also has a default is valid OAS and appears in the official example.
